traditional_uses: Often used topically to soothe minor skin irritation.
Used in some cosmetic and skin-care products.
preparation_notes: Usually applied externally as fresh gel after proper plant identification.
Use clean handling and avoid applying homemade preparations to deep or infected wounds.

traditional_uses: Traditionally used for skin and oral-care preparations.
Leaves are used in some traditional pest-repellent preparations.
preparation_notes: Traditional preparations vary by region and should be verified with a qualified herbal expert.
Avoid concentrated extracts unless guided by a professional.
Azadirachta_indica.safety_warning: Neem oil and concentrated extracts can be unsafe if misused, especially for children and pregnant users.
Azadirachta_indica.medical_disclaimer: This information is educational and is not a substitute for medical advice.

traditional_uses: Traditionally used in some herbal systems for digestive and respiratory wellness.
Rhizomes are commonly referenced in traditional preparations.
preparation_notes: Traditional preparations often use the rhizome rather than leaves.
Use only verified plant material and professional guidance before preparation.
Alpinia Galanga (Rasna).safety_warning: Avoid medicinal use during pregnancy, chronic illness, or medication use without professional advice.
Alpinia Galanga (Rasna).medical_disclaimer: This app provides educational plant information only and is not medical advice.

traditional_uses: Traditionally used as a leafy green vegetable in several regions.
Used in food-based preparations rather than concentrated herbal dosing.
preparation_notes: Leaves are commonly cooked as greens after proper washing.
Avoid plants collected from polluted areas because leafy greens can accumulate contaminants.
Amaranthus Viridis (Arive-Dantu).safety_warning: People with kidney stone risk or special diets should ask a clinician before frequent medicinal use.
Amaranthus Viridis (Arive-Dantu).medical_disclaimer: This information is educational and is not a substitute for medical or dietary advice.

traditional_uses: Traditionally used in bitter herbal preparations.
Commonly referenced in traditional wellness practices for seasonal illness support.
preparation_notes: Preparations and dose vary widely by tradition and should not be guessed from identification alone.
Use qualified guidance before preparing concentrated extracts or decoctions.
Andrographis paniculata (Nelavembu).safety_warning: May interact with medicines and may be unsuitable during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or autoimmune conditions.
Andrographis paniculata (Nelavembu).medical_disclaimer: This app does not diagnose or treat illness and is not a replacement for medical care.

traditional_uses: Traditionally referenced for several plant parts in regional herbal knowledge.
The fruit is commonly consumed as food when ripe.
preparation_notes: Different plant parts have different safety profiles; do not prepare leaves, seeds, or bark casually.
Seeds should not be eaten or crushed for home remedies.
Annona squamosa (Seethapala).safety_warning: Seeds and some concentrated plant preparations can be unsafe. Keep away from children and avoid self-medication.
